title: Gorgeous Clean 4BR Home Near Downtown Nashville
description:
Welcome home to this spacious 4 bedroom, 3 1/2 bath newly updated two story duplex within 1.3mi to Downtown Nashville, 2.5mi to Vandy and 3.2mi to Belmont. A short 25 min walk or 5 min by car to the Broadway Honkeytonks, shopping, LP Field, and the Predators Bridgestone Arena and another few steps to the Country Music Hall of Fame and brand new Music City Center.
It is perfect for family getaways, friends gatherings and business travelers.
For more reviews, visit https://www.vrbo.com/605398

The space
The main level is inviting with a large well-equipped and newly renovated kitchen with formal dining area, a large living room with comfortable sectional sofa and flat screen TV, and main level bedroom with en-s
uite bathroom. The second level will shower you with all of the comforts of home as you enjoy our spacious bedrooms and luxurious bathrooms. Revel in our spacious master bedroom and private deck with spectacular views of downtown.

Come enjoy your home away from home here in Music City!

For additional reviews from our guests at this location, visit our VBRO listing  https://www.vrbo.com/605398. We have been hosting this house on VBRO since  2014.

If you are interested in this house and it is not available, check out our other location: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/25007949.

Guest access
It is your home when you are our guests.

Other things to note
